name: A1 Gallery
official_name_basis: ChatGPTプラグイン詳細画面の表示名
original_description: Search a hand-curated gallery of 1,250+ real websites by style, category, technology, font and colour, each with the live URL, its tags and a screenshot. Ask for a design brief and get 5 real examples plus the type sizes, widths, fonts and colours sites like it use. Search 6,800+ captured sections such as heroes, pricing tables and FAQs, each with the colours, type sizes, spacing and radius measured off the live page. Compare sites side by side, browse full-page captures, find font pairings in use and see who built each site. Save what you find to your own A1 boards. Needs an A1 account.
embedded_app_description: Search a hand-curated gallery of 1,150+ real websites by style, category, technology, font and colour. Each result has the live URL, its tags and a screenshot. Search 2,800+ captured sections such as heroes, feature grids and FAQs by what they say, and read the colours, type sizes, spacing and radius measured off the live page. Browse full-page captures by page type, find font pairings in use on real sites, and see who built each site. All tools are read-only and need an A1 account.
summary_ja: 実在するウェブサイトや各ページのデザイン事例を検索・比較する。
limitations_ja: 本文はサイト1,250件以上・セクション6,800件以上およびボードへの保存を説明。一方、内包アプリ欄は1,150件以上・2,800件以上で全ツール読み取り専用と説明。件数・保存機能の実際の対応は未確認。A1アカウントが必要。
review: ChatGPTの詳細画面に基づく記録。実動作・料金・一覧本体との照合は未検証。
